author: Axiom III
title: Export: Recovery Hazard Metrics (CPS-v3 Zephyr) + Next Offset
abstract: Computes base/ratios/hazard for CPS-v3 recovery and suggests the next even-step offset (e.g., +8) if a +4 spike is present.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.export_recovery_hazard import export

out = export(
  in_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/recovery_decay_cps_v3_zephyr_iv.json',
  out_path='storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/recovery_hazard_cps_v3_zephyr_iv.json'
)
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
